caveat_perindopril: REVISION-ASYMMETRIC. A ran calls 1-48 under the launch revision and 49-250 under the current one after a preemption strand; B ran all 250 under the launch revision. Arm-A state identity across that boundary was measured at 2 differing leaves of 218,865+ (both new bookkeeping keys holding None), so it is unlikely to explain a 0.023 AUC gap -- but a clean single-revision rerun of A at 250 would settle it and has not been run.
consequence: Do not scale this controller to 23x10k. Its benefit is task-dependent and, on the task where it wins, its BEST saturates at call 500 while only top-10 fills in -- exploitation inside a found basin with discovery stalled. The next controller work targets the proposal law (global route prototypes), not allocation or more budget.
headline: Online structural memory is TASK-DEPENDENT, not a universal win: 1 clean win, 1 hollow win, 1 loss across three matched 250-call tasks.
supersedes_framing: An earlier coordinator summary said the memory effect 'is real and persists with budget'. That is supported for celecoxib and was generalised further than three tasks allow. Corrected here.

celecoxib_rediscovery.note: clean win; B also holds at 1000 calls (AUC 0.2489 -> 0.3138) but its BEST froze at call 500

gsk3b.note: HOLLOW: the official score is legitimate and stays in the table, but B's top-10 are chemically worse (QED 0.367 vs 0.423, SA 6.31 vs 6.12) and memory strengthens r(score,SA) 0.456 -> 0.668. B exploits the predictor harder.

perindopril_mpo.note: A BEATS B by +0.0234 AUC and +0.0153 best. Memory is a net negative on this landscape.
